files.description: Canonical artifact: generated openapi.json, manifest, and SHA256SUMS. Consumers pin an immutable release tag and checksum.
Generated artifacts cannot be hand-edited. Schema corrections are issues. Validation stays deterministic and offline.
Artifact CalVer, compatibility classification (initial, compatible, breaking), and immutable release behavior.
Vulnerability reports go to support@samva.dev. Ordinary schema corrections use the public issue tracker.
